dataset: National Heritage List for England NHLE v02 VIEW / Listed Building polygons
evidence_slice: Historic England's official National Heritage List for England NHLE v02 FeatureServer identifies layer 3 as Listed Building polygons. Official metadata states polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011 and that area_ha is only populated where a building footprint has been mapped. Target List Entry 1495589 is Exeter Central Station, a station building first listed on 24 July 2026. The selected single-record GeoJSON query requested ListEntry, Name, Grade, list dates, capture scale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, Easting/Northing and geometry in EPSG:4326, but the response was not retrievable through the available web channel; a direct network attempt also failed at DNS resolution before any feature payload was returned.

field_evidence.footprint: Layer 3 is the official Listed Building polygons layer; metadata states area_ha is only populated where a building footprint has been mapped. The target feature geometry was not returned, so no footprint polygon coordinates were verified.
field_evidence.type_use: Target List Entry 1495589 is Exeter Central Station; the official NHLE record name explicitly evidences station building type/use, but the selected polygon-query payload itself was not returned.
field_evidence.coverage: Historic England metadata states listed-building polygons are available for buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011; target List Entry 1495589 was first listed on 24 July 2026.
